name: articulation_points_bridges
author: 8f0a9ac4
description: Finds articulation points (nodes) and bridges (edges) disconnects the graph. It answers network-resilience questions. It supports directed and undirected graphs, treating directed edges as undirected for this structural analysis, and returns deterministic node and edge references.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum number of articulation points and bridges to return for each result list.
